name: prepare-design-brief
title_zh: 比赛功能定稿后自动生成设计师交接文档
tagline_zh: 功能规格一敲定，设计提案书自动成形。不用再追着设计师解释需求，也不用担心交接时漏掉关键细节，文档结构清晰。
tagline_en: Feature spec locked? The design proposal doc is ready. No more chasing designers or missing handoff.
desc_en: Create a designer handoff from an agreed competition feature specification. Use only when the user asks for 디자인제안서 or designer delivery; optional to the main competition workflow.
why_zh: 它把「功能规格」到「设计师交接」这条最容易被忽略的链路自动化，让比赛流程不卡在沟通上。
why_en: It automates the most overlooked link—from feature spec to designer handoff—so your competition flow never stalls on.
limit_zh: 只在用户明确要求「디자인제안서」或设计师交付时触发；不覆盖完整比赛流程，也不替代设计师的创意判断。
limit_en: Triggers only when '디자인제안서' or designer delivery is requested; not a full competition pipeline, no creative judgment, output is a structured doc.
title_en: Generate a designer handoff doc from an agreed feature spec
